name: ComplexFunBench

task_type_en: Complex function calling, multi-step travel booking, audio adaptation

intro_en: The site's legacy ID ComplexFunBench corresponds to the paper's official name ComplexFuncBench, a 1,000-sample benchmark for complex travel-booking function calls. The original paper builds a text-to-text multi-step, constrained, long-context evaluation with ComplexEval; Google later synthesizes audio for every prompt, runs it through the Gemini Live API, and retains the published scorer.
metric_en: Success Rate, Call Accuracy, Completeness, Correctness
drawio_review_note: Aligned with ComplexFuncBench arXiv:2501.10132 Sections 2–3, its official repository, and Google DeepMind's March 2026 Gemini 3.1 Flash Live evaluation report/model card. The site's ComplexFunBench spelling is retained only as an asset and page ID; the original benchmark name is ComplexFuncBench. The authors manually correct 43 Booking.com/RapidAPI functions across hotel, flight, attraction, car-rental, and taxi domains. GPT-4o creates 1,000 coarse queries and preliminary paths; senior annotators select 100 relatively complete samples, rewrite queries, correct parameter values and call order to the shortest complete path, remove overlapping functions and ambiguous API results, and quality-check the templates. GPT-4o generates nine variants per template and junior annotators fill parameters and disambiguate responses, yielding 1,000 items: 600 single-domain and 400 cross-domain. ComplexEval performs format checks, embedding-based Hungarian mapping, and rule-, response-, or GPT-4o-based equivalence, then reports success rate and call accuracy; GPT-4o separately scores final-response completeness and correctness from 0 to 2. Google's audio adaptation synthesizes audio for each prompt, runs the static-context multi-turn benchmark through the Gemini Live API, and explicitly reuses the published scoring apparatus rather than defining a new benchmark construction.
